## Summary

Describe the affected client, Python, C++, admin, database, configuration, test, documentation, or site area.

## Validation

- [ ] I recorded runtime/compiler versions and commands.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I reviewed compatibility, migration, fairness, privacy, and rollback impact.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, player data, payment records, production endpoints, or unlicensed assets.
- [ ] I updated documentation and the changelog where needed.

## Evidence

Provide sanitized logs, screenshots, test results, or a minimal reproduction.
